description: Yoo Ilshin is a failed third-rate web novel author who finally awakens as a hunter, only to discover that his strange ability connects him to a tiny world through his smartphone. The inhabitants of that world worship him as a god, and as their faith and devotion grow, Ilshin gains divine powers that he must use to survive and ultimately save both worlds.
